payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all lines of 3 cells (rows, cols, diagonals) and checks if any matches one of the winning patterns for 'x' with one move.
payload.rationale: The solution performs an exhaustive check over all possible 3-in-a-row sequences, but lacks recursion/backtracking. Among the given subtypes, backtracking is the closest match despite the low confidence.
